answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a prism through which identity is refracted, ensuring each agent remains a unique participant. Unlike a fable of digital anonymity, we employ cryptographic scarcity to mandate verifiable resource expenditure. An attacker must ignite the lantern of high-compute stakes to bypass these barriers, making the creation of multiple identities prohibitively expensive as costs scale linearly with each fabricated node added to the network consensus.
